name: fran-carmine-spark-on-attack-banishes-opponents-fire-graveyard-card-and-empowers
notes: Fran, Carmine Spark On Attack: the chosen graveyard card is banished (to its owner's banishment) and a fire card empowers 3. Pre-fix the move used an undefined ->Owner (null), flipping the zone perspective so the wrong card moved.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Attack: Target player banishes a card from their graveyard. If a fire element card was banished this way, you empower 3.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. FranCarmineSparkBanish called MZMove($obj->Owner, ...), but graveyard objects have no Owner property: the null player flipped the zone perspective (own-graveyard picks moved the opponent's card; the banished card went to the wrong side). It now moves the chosen card to the banishment on the side of the graveyard it came from.
